Name: VTuber curlycat (Custom NPC)
Author: curly333
Description:
[i]VTuber [b]curlycat[/b] has come to Stardew Valley! You can now befriend him! And who knows, maybe your friendship will flower into something more...?
[/i]
[b]curlycat[/b] (written without caps) is a french canadian VTuber who streams variety content in english. He aims to stream comfy (and most of the time family friendly) content. He claims to be a ''very very good and nice catboy''. He enjoys headpats and dislikes bonks. His birthday is on June 5th.

You can now have one of your favorite catboy VTuber live in the forest next to your farm!

[i]''curlycat has been living with Leah for a while... He doesn't really interact with anyone outside of Leah, so you might not have heard about him yet. He mostly hangs out in the forest south of your farm, but sometimes you can also find him in the Saloon, on his own, playing one of the arcade games. He can be very shy at first, but I think it's worth giving him a chance.''[/i]



[b][size=4]PixelArt by [url=https://twitter.com/BlueCipherRPG]BlueCipherRPG
[/url]Mod made with the help of ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4701]Miss Coriel's NPC Creator[/url][/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Known bugs:[/size][/b]
- If you're adding this mod and play on a save file that existed before installing the mod, curlycat will not follow his schedule. [b]Solution:[/b] You need to talk to him at least once. The next day, his schedule should be just fine! You might have to work a little harder to meet him if that's the case, since he lives in Leah's Cottage at the moment...
- curlycat's dialogues don't seem to be working if he is hanging out in his Spouse Room (when married).
[b]
Please report bugs to curlycatofficial@gmail.com[/b]



[b][size=4]How to install this mod:[/size][/b]
- Download this mod and the other necessities linked down below, install them as explained on their own page
- Find your Stardew Valley folder, in your SV folder find your Mod folder, and put the two folders of this mod inside it
[url=https://twitter.com/BlueCipherRPG]
[/url][b][size=3]To use my curlycat mod, you also need these mods:[/size][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820]TMXL Map Toolkit[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url]

[b][size=3]And you also need:[/size][/b]
[url=https://smapi.io/]﻿SMAPI



[/url][b][size=4]Hints to befriend curlycat:[/size][/b]
- curlycat's birthday is Summer 5
- curlycat likes fishes!
- curlycat enjoy the forest below your farm, but also the Saloon



[size=5][b]Thank you for everything and have fun![/b][/size]
